images.title: l and ml on a double number line, and 20 cups from 4 l
images.purpose: Show that l to ml is × 1,000 and ml to l is ÷ 1,000 (1 l, 4 l and 6 l with their ml), and that 4 l poured into 200 ml cups fills 20 cups.
images.composition: A double number line of l and ml with three matching ticks and two arrows at the top, and two rows of ten cups with the division below.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LINE: a thin dark #1F2937 horizontal line at y 190 from x 130 to x 1326 with an open circle (14 px) at each end, and exactly 3 vertical tick marks (40 px tall, 4 px thick) at x 260, 730, 1200, equally spaced (the marks are not drawn to scale). The unit word l (40 px, bold, teal #0072B2) is at the left end, x 60, above the line. BOTTOM LINE: the same kind of line at y 360 with the same 3 tick marks at the same x positions, directly under the top ticks. The unit word ml (40 px, bold, amber #E69F00) is at the left end, x 60, below the line. TOP LABELS (centred on the tick, 40 px, bold, dark #1F2937, about y 120): 1 l at x 260; 4 l at x 730; 6 l at x 1200. BOTTOM LABELS (centred on the tick, 40 px, bold, dark #1F2937, about y 440): 1,000 ml at x 260; 4,000 ml at x 730; 6,000 ml at x 1200. ARROW: a dashed teal #0072B2 curved arrow from the top tick at x 730 down to the bottom tick at x 730, arrowhead at the bottom, with the label × 1,000 (40 px, bold, teal) beside its middle. ARROW: a dashed amber #E69F00 curved arrow from the bottom tick at x 1200 up to the top tick at x 1200, arrowhead at the top, with the label ÷ 1,000 (40 px, bold, amber) beside its middle. CUPS: 20 small cups in 2 rows of 10 at y 560 to 610 and y 640 to 690, each a trapezoid 56 px wide at the top and 40 px wide at the bottom, 44 px tall, filled pale teal #CCE5F2 with a 3 px outline #1F2937, left edges from x 126 in steps of 120 px (x 126 to x 1206), with the text 200 ml on the first cup only (24 px). A label 4,000 ÷ 200 = 20 cups (44 px, bold, dark #1F2937) centred at x 728, y 760. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any count of tick marks that differs from 3 on each line
any count of cups that differs from 20
an l and ml pair that does not match
images.takeaway: l to ml is × 1,000 and ml to l is ÷ 1,000; to count small containers, change both to ml and divide.
images.description: A double number line of l and ml (1 l, 4 l, 6 l) with arrows, and 20 cups of 200 ml filled from 4 l.
images.context: Concept image for Litres into Millilitres, and Back. It follows the idea of the l and ml double number line in your maths book and uses the concept's own example (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Read a tick on both lines, then count the cups. The slip to watch: thinking 1 l is 100 ml.

image_decisions.why: The line shows the unit change and the cups show how many small containers a big one fills.
